name: Workbench P-005 native Windows resident host and service-station guard
summary: Maintained registered PowerShell fixture compiled actual WPF/Win32 production sources on native Windows. All 23 model/shortcut/HWND cases passed in signed-in desktop Session 1; the separate preflight regression passed in SSH/service Session 0 and refused startup before allocating a window or shortcut. Native Node wrapper was not run on this VM because Node is absent; Linux wrapper loaded with two selected Windows tests skipped. This is native fixture evidence, not installed-app or shipment acceptance.
custody: Native Get-FileHash matched canonical SHA256 before and after the full run; canonical bytes remained unchanged.

rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: The SSH-launched fixture used a noninteractive service window station, which cannot register global hotkeys.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The host registration implementation cannot register these valid shortcuts even on the interactive user desktop.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: Use native WSF_VISIBLE to identify the station; invoke the same compiled production host through an owned InteractiveToken scheduled task, and verify service-station constructor refusal separately.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: Interactive station registers F10/F11 and completes ownership/rollback/window checks; service station refuses before allocating shortcuts.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: Valid shortcut registration still fails in a visible signed-in station.

rootCauseVerification.actualObservation: Native interactiveDesktop=true / processSessionId=1 passed 23 checks; interactiveDesktop=false / processSessionId=0 passed the early-refusal regression. Earlier first registration of F11 failed with Win32Exception: This operation requires an interactive window station.
rootCauseVerification.testProcedure: Registered native-workbench-windows.test.mjs delegates to the maintained host fixture; this VM directly executed its exact PowerShell fixture using SSH only as control transport.

scopeLimits: Quick Access and Goals host fixture only; other four native panels remain required
Real operator integration, exact terminal focus/resume and canonical GUI content parity remain required
Full independent exact installed-artifact Ubuntu/macOS/Windows acceptance and shipment remain required
